name: Elf
desc: Graceful, long-lived and keen-eyed folk of the old forests.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.desc: Proficient in Perception; +2 when scanning for hidden things.

traits.name: Trance
traits.desc: Short rests restore 2 extra Spell Points and 25% more HP.

name: Dwarf
desc: Stout, stubborn, and carved from the same stone as their halls.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.desc: Resistant to poison damage; poison wears off twice as fast.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.desc: +3 to checks in ruins, mountains and dungeons; spots traps more easily.

name: Human
desc: Ambitious, adaptable, and found absolutely everywhere.

traits.name: Skilled
traits.desc: Gain proficiency in one extra skill of your choice.

traits.name: Determined
traits.desc: Start each long rest with 1 Inspiration if you have none.

name: Orc
desc: Fierce, proud and unbreakable warriors of the hard places.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.desc: Once per long rest, when dropped to 0 HP you stay up with 1 HP.

traits.name: Aggressive Charge
traits.desc: Bonus action: your next attack gains +1d6 damage.

name: Dragonborn
desc: Proud scaled folk who carry the blood — and breath — of dragons.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.desc: Blow into the mic to exhale your ancestry's element on up to 3 foes.

traits.name: Draconic Resistance
traits.desc: Resistant to your ancestry's damage type.
